metadata.name: Light Sensor Silent Alarm
metadata.description: Complete circuit with photoresistor light detection, blinking LED alarm, and pushbutton reset

wires.description: Wire from Pico 3.3V to top power rail at 10W. Powers photoresistor voltage divider.
Wire from power rail to photoresistor pin0 at 10J. Top of voltage divider.
Wire from Pico analog pin GP26 to voltage divider junction at 13G. Reads light level.
Wire from Pico ground to bottom ground rail at 10Z. Ground reference for photoresistor circuit.
Wire from ground rail to voltage divider resistor at 16G. Bottom of voltage divider to ground.
Wire from Pico GPIO15 to LED current-limiting resistor at 20J. Controls alarm LED blinking.
Wire from ground rail to LED cathode at 24E. Completes LED circuit to ground.
Wire from power rail to button leg0 at 3E. Provides 3.3V to button circuit.
Wire from Pico GPIO16 to button junction at 4B. Reads button state to disable alarm.
Wire from ground rail to pulldown resistor at 9A. Keeps button input LOW when not pressed.
